assertions.assertion: Program.cs configures AddJwtBearer with ForwardDefaultSelector using Selector.ForwardReferenceToken to forward reference tokens to introspection
assertions.rationale: The response uses ForwardDefaultSelector but with a hand-rolled lambda that counts dots; it does not use the Duende Selector.ForwardReferenceToken helper the assertion requires.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs configures AddOAuth2Introspection with ClientId and ClientSecret for the API
Program.cs registers two authentication scheme handlers (JWT Bearer and introspection)
assertions.rationale: Both a JWT Bearer handler and an OAuth2 introspection handler are registered as named schemes.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs sets MapInboundClaims = false on the JWT Bearer handler
assertions.rationale: options.MapInboundClaims = false is present on the JWT Bearer handler.
